notes.title: Version 1.3 - Lazers!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27903609/aad8e8c7521a4c6ab52330ae5a12906e8eb5cad0.jpg[/img]

This is the biggest update yet and I believe it addresses a lot of the feedback I've got about the game in the past months in a way that is practical and fits with the game design.

I wont change the base gameplay anymore except for balancing tweaks. But I'd like to add some more enemies, we'll see.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Laser upgrade.
[*]Each ship upgrade uses a different weapon.
[*]The turret turns slower if you thrust. More noticeable on the Tank/Laser upgrade.
[*]After each upgrade cycle the ship levels up.
[*]Each ship level up does more damage but its also harder to get.
[*]Ship level is shown on the scoreboard.
[*]Several tweaks to the difficulty (I might need few more updates to get it right).
[*]UI signalling for mines.
[*]Option to disable the gamepad cursor.

notes.title: Version 1.25 - Better
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Better targeting
[*]New mechanic: no thrust = reload missiles
[*]Visual cue when missiles are ready
[*][strike]Score combo is kept alive during upgrades[/strike] (no more, was too easy)
[*]Some fixes to gamepad controls
[/list]

The new missiles mechanic adds some more depth to the gameplay, basically if you want more firepower you need to hold you thrust and risk getting shot down.

notes.title: Version 1.21 - Quickie
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Camera target option (set "direction" if you want the original setting)
[*]A couple of bugfixes
[/list]

To elaborate a bit more on the camera target: it is the point the camera tries to focus on. Originally it was ahead of your ship, now you can choose to focus in the cursor/aiming direction or mix the two (the default).
